verdict.rationale: Docs show recall() auto-classifies queries and picks a retrieval strategy, implying multiple underlying search strategies exist, but there is no explicit documentation of developer-facing controls for metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking options that a developer can select to steer retrieval away from a single similarity search. Missing for 10: explicit API/params for metadata filtering, keyword/hybrid toggle, and reranking configuration, plus any independent confirmation these modes are user-selectable.
